implementation: C core plus Python binding; DCT-zero JPEG-grid origin and localized anomaly detection
build: Compiled with existing WSL Ubuntu GCC and system libjpeg/libpng/libtiff; Windows native make was unavailable.
controlledRun: One real controlled camera source and its Pillow Q95 JPEG descendant; output captured separately.
limitations: A single pair is an oracle smoke test, not qualification.
Grid findings are manipulation/context evidence, not authorship.
Non-8-pixel crop has changed dimensions and cannot be compared by ZERO's two-image command without a matched pre-crop source.
